integrity: Mathematical proof and finite exact diagnostics supplied; no external proof certification or independent audit; stated external inputs credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite tuples of pairwise singular positive probabilities on perfect compact metric spaces; no classification of arbitrary signed annihilators. Baire genericity is in measure-tuple topology, not a subspace Grassmannian. The inverse-tolerance Lipschitz exponent, not leading constant, is proved sharp for one explicit interval pair. Broader contractive-projection theory may affect priority.
title: Generic nonattainment at the least finite-codimensional projection constant
